title: Exact strict point-system functors and normalized chain transport
statement: Fix D, ell and E as in [def-trf-coefficient-conventions] and [def-trf-scheme-frobenius]. On the actual coefficient ringed sequence site [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], postcomposition by the rth geometric Frobenius power defines the strict-system inverse image pull, using the unique sectionwise inverse coefficient identification. This inverse image and whole-tower sections are additive and preserve finite limits and colimits. Their termwise complex functors admit a unique natural chain transformation whose (i,n) component, on sections over the final pro-etale object, is the original presheaf restriction along the vertical point arrow. This statement is for ell different from D.p and r at least one; the functors themselves and their exactness are defined for every r. Site and coefficient universes are independent, and exponent n means n+1. The attached Lean module supplies the unchanged explicit constructions and their normalization theorems, ending with the two derived-functor abbreviations.

proof.text: Use the actual product of index identity and pro-etale postcomposition. The uniquely specified coefficient map and normalized chain transformation are those of [lem-trf-point-restriction-system-chain-map], so their uniqueness specifications transfer directly. For exactness of inverse image, the inverse pro-etale postcomposition of [lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image] yields an equivalence on underlying abelian sheaves. Module forgetful functors reflect the preserved finite limits and colimits. For exactness of whole-tower sections, [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] supplies the restriction to finite levels; the independent-universe point-section calculation in [lem-weil-point-automorphism-restriction-natural], implementing [lem-weil-point-proetale-sections-exact], is exact. Scalar restriction and tower whiskering preserve these limits and colimits. Apply these exact functors termwise and transfer the uniquely prescribed chain map. All definitions and proofs in this extracted module are the existing construction, with no new choice or hypothesis. Zero modules, r=0 for the functors, and arbitrary unbounded complexes remain valid.
